title: Promote the digest, not the tag
scenario: "Audit asked: how do you know prod runs the exact bytes you tested? A tag can be re-pushed." — Security review
mission: Change the pipeline and chart so deploy PRs pin images by digest, and promotion copies the digest.
objectives: Render images as repo@sha256 in the chart

prerequisites.notes: Offline-friendly: workflow and chart changes are validated without the cluster.

steps.detail: The bump and promote steps in app.yml.

steps.title: Capture the digest
steps.detail: Read the pushed digest (az acr repository show or docker buildx metadata).

steps.title: Template support
steps.detail: portal.image helper renders @digest when set, tag otherwise.

steps.title: Prove it
steps.detail: helm template shows image: <repo>@sha256:... for prod.

criteria.text: app.yml writes a digest into the deploy PR
Promotion copies the digest from dev to prod
The chart renders repo@sha256 when a digest is set
helm lint passes for dev and prod

concepts.title: Tags are mutable, digests are not
concepts.body: An image tag (`v1.2.0`) is a pointer that can be re-pushed to different content. A digest (`sha256:…`) is the hash of the image manifest: same digest, same bytes. Deploying `repo@sha256:…` guarantees prod runs what was tested.

concepts.title: Getting the digest
concepts.body: Registries return the digest on push; ACR can show it later for a tag. Keep the human-readable tag too — the smoke test compares the version string.

example.title: digest of an existing tag
example.code: az acr repository show -n <acr> --image <repo>:<tag> --query digest -o tsv

interview.question: Tag vs digest: what would you deploy to production and why?
followUps: How does image signing fit (cosign / Notation)?

debrief: Digests are immutable and content-addressed; promotion by digest guarantees bit-for-bit equality between environments. Keep the tag for humans and for the smoke version check.
